---
name: Feature or enhancement request
about: Propose a focused product improvement or new capability.
title: "Enhancement: "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ""
---

## Duplicate check

- [ ] I searched existing issues and pull requests for a matching request before opening this.

## Affected area

Choose the closest area, or write a short description if none fits:

- Admin UI / setup
- Assistant connection / OAuth
- MCP tools / abilities
- Content, media, comments, or site health workflows
- Integrations
- Documentation
- Other:

## Current behavior or gap

What is hard, missing, inefficient, or not yet supported?

## Expected behavior

What should the product enable, change, or improve?

## Evidence or examples

Add user stories, screenshots, workflow notes, comparable product behavior, or implementation constraints when useful.

## Product impact

Who benefits, what workflow improves, and how important is this compared with other work?

## Proposed milestone or risk

If known, note the target milestone, delivery risk, compatibility concern, or reason this can wait.

## Validation expectations

What would prove the enhancement is complete and safe to ship?

## Public safety check

- [ ] This request does not include secrets, access tokens, private site data, customer data, or sensitive request/response payloads.
